summary_bullets: Move accepted non-security OOS filing upstream into /design Step 5b so URLs land before the larch:plan write, with a sentinel and annotate helper mirroring /implement patterns.
Split /design Step 5 into finalize (5a–5c) versus Step 6 cleanup-only so breadcrumbs and registry names match what operators actually run.
Let /implement skip design-pre-filed OOS blocks and union multiple disposition-gate URL files so design-side Filed URL lines satisfy the gate alongside implement tmp artifacts.
Document the workflow in README, skills, lifecycle, and CHANGELOG; wire Makefile test-file-design-oos into the harness shard used by lint.
Fix shellcheck/agent-lint issues in the new helper and structure tests (case patterns, grep quoting, SKILL harness pins).
commit_message:
Design: file OOS in 5b; split finalize vs cleanup; union filed URLs in gate

- Add file-design-oos.sh prepare/annotate pipeline, sentinel idempotency, and offline harness
- Extend oos-disposition-gate for repeatable --filed-urls-file; document and test union semantics
- Renumber /design finalize steps (5b OOS, 5c plan) and Step 6 cleanup; tighten test-design-structure pins
- Update /implement Step 9a.1 and consumer docs; Makefile target test-file-design-oos
todos_left: Optional manual smoke: /design --trivial on an issue with accepted non-security OOS; confirm [OOS] titles, Filed URL lines, [DESIGNED] ordering, and no double-file on re-run within the session.

oos_observations.title: Disposition gate URL union can false-positive on incidental issue links in OOS prose
oos_observations.description: count_filed_urls_union_files treats any matching https://github.com/.../issues/<n> substring across filed-url inputs as satisfying disposition. Reviewer see-also URLs inside OOS descriptions could therefore satisfy the gate without a true per-block filing. Plan called this out as deferred hardening; consider scoping counts to structured Filed URL lines or per-block extracts if this shows up in production.
